title: fix(cli): skip the doc preamble when filtering polli docs by endpoint
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: `polli docs` filters for `/image`, `/text`, `/audio`, `/video`, and `/embeddings` no longer include the generic documentation preamble. Heading matching now skips chunks that do not start with a heading, while the existing body-match fallback remains unchanged. The `@pollinations/cli` version was bumped from 0.1.37 to 0.1.38, and regression tests cover preamble handling for `/image`, `/text`, and `/audio`.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny librarian glasses and helps a CRT monitor robot sort documentation pages into labeled image, text, and audio sections, leaving the generic preamble aside; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants glow against warm cream and soft pastel gradients, with dark purple (#110518) outlines. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
